rule: Every lesson in this release declares schema_version = the release-wide value. Where the authoring lane emitted a different value it is preserved verbatim in authored_schema_version, so nothing is lost and the change is invertible.
inverse: schema_version := authored_schema_version if present, then drop the field.
why_not_widen_the_const: release/lesson-schema.json pins schema_version to const '1.0'. Widening it to an enum was the alternative and is rejected here: a release package should present one schema version to its consumers. The ELA 1.1 records are a strict superset of the 1.0 field set (39 fields vs 30-38, all additive) and the schema sets additionalProperties: true, so a 1.1 record is a valid 1.0 record. The authored value stays on the record either way.
